description: This file defines a Java class 'MessageOnlyLogFilter' that implements the 'LogNode' interface. Its purpose is to filter log messages by passing only the message content to the next LogNode in the chain, disregarding other metadata such as priority, tag, and throwable objects. It is used to simplify log output, especially for on-screen logs where minimal information is preferred.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class that implements LogNode and filters log messages to only pass the message content to the next node.
